title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Every night I attempt to sleep according to the Sunnah. However, being a restless sleeper, I can never sleep in one position for too long so I always end up sleeping in a different position. What do you recommend I do at this point? 2203 views Q. Dream 1271 views Q. I saw a dream a week ago, before Fajr. I saw that three adult pigs and a small one were standing outside the main entrance of my house 1949 views Q. Doing tawaf in dream 7842 views Q. Dream 1329 views Q. Some people say roohanis and jins and shaitan catches some people and because of this they become mad. Is it true and please clarify. 1746 views Q. I dreamt that it was the day of yaumul qiyamah and I was standing in a room, then my late grandmother came to me and greated me, then my great grandmother also came happy as well as my grandfather. They were happy about something, but didnt say anything. I then dreamt that I proceeded to a qabrstaan where my mother was buried, and she wasnot resurrected with the rest of us as a result of sacrifises that she had made for us in this dunya. Dream 2: My Aunt told me that she dreamt my fatherinlaw who is recently late crying and trying to tell her something. When he parted it was after our families had a huge fight, but he did tell us to make peace with each other before he went. 2758 views Q. I work in a software company here in India - Some days back, I saw in my dream my manager telling me to resign from the job(Lay off) after this dream I am perplexed as to what is this dream about- 1) Is it the indication I Should resgin from job 2) Is this dream Satan's whisper to cause distress 3) I am completely confused and I am praying Allah (Rabbul izzath) to guide me to the right path. Pls help in the interpretation of this dream. Jazakallah. 1467 views Q. 1.what is the fate of non baligh children who die?will they get jannat ul firdous as they r sinless? Why is that they are not required to endure the test of the world wereas we r supposed to face the hardships? How is that they get the jannat just like that and we have to work to get the same jannat? 2. what is the Islamic ruling regarding haermophrodites(bisexual)? In the quran allah mentions only about two genders whereas there is no mention of the third gender? 3 when does rooh(soul) enter the foetus?on the day of judgment will only those who were bestowed with rooh will be raised ...? 1801 views Q. My sister on Sunday 6/2/2011 dream that she was praying salat while two other sunnoty dressed man was also praying salat. 1408 views Q. dream of seeing rauza sharif 6151 views Q. Problems in My Marriage, Please advice 1974 views Q. Dream Interpretation 1820 views Q. Dear Mufti Saahab, May Allah(SWT) bless you with the best for the work you are doing. Few days ago a very pious person passed away in our town. He was not a Aalim or Haafeez but a Daaiee who was involved very much in the work of Daawaah. I wasn't there in my town during that time neither was I close to this person during his hayaat but, use to see him often while going and coming from prayers. Coming to the point. I with my family and my brother-in-law were discussing about this person after which we went to sleep. I dreamt about the person who passed away that "It is a time for prayers (Don't remember which prayer but, I feel Magrib) and this person is asking me to lead the prayers and upon his saying I led the prayers and I started reciting aayaahs (Qiraat) and I remember that I was stopping after each aayaah and was very slow in recitation (Don't remember which aayaahs). This person whom I am talking about, in the state of Salaah started reading the Aayaahs louder and little faster and I taught he is prompting me and even I started reciting it fast. Please interpret this dream of mine (Jazaakumullah). 1528 views Q. Ulama and Akabir 5323 views
answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 57662 Country: India Title: میرے دوست نے مجھ کو IESامتحان (سرکاری امتحان)دینے کا مشورہ دیا۔ میں نے ایک ہفتہ تک استخارہ کیا۔ چوتھے دن رات میں تقریباً ایک بجے کے قریب میں نے خواب دیکھا کہ میں ایک کار چلا رہا ہوں، سامنے قطار میں شیطان کھڑے ہیں ۔ ان میں سے ہر ایک روڈ پر مجھ کو پکڑنے کی کوشش کرتا ہے لیکن میں ان میں سے ہر ایک سے بچ جاتا ہوں۔ اس کے بعد اچانک ایک دیوار یا درخت کے سامنے آتا ہوں اور اچانک میری آنکھ کھل جاتی ہے۔ میں نے اپنی آنکھیں کھولیں۔ میں نے دعا پڑھی اور دوبارہ سو گیا۔ Question: میرے دوست نے مجھ کو IESامتحان (سرکاری امتحان)دینے کا مشورہ دیا۔ میں نے ایک ہفتہ تک استخارہ کیا۔ چوتھے دن رات میں تقریباً ایک بجے کے قریب میں نے خواب دیکھا کہ میں ایک کار چلا رہا ہوں، سامنے قطار میں شیطان کھڑے ہیں ۔ ان میں سے ہر ایک روڈ پر مجھ کو پکڑنے کی کوشش کرتا ہے لیکن میں ان میں سے ہر ایک سے بچ جاتا ہوں۔ اس کے بعد اچانک ایک دیوار یا درخت کے سامنے آتا ہوں اور اچانک میری آنکھ کھل جاتی ہے۔ میں نے اپنی آنکھیں کھولیں۔ میں نے دعا پڑھی اور دوبارہ سو گیا۔ Answer ID: 57662 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! Fatwa ID: 288-300/N=4/1436-U اگر استخارہ کے بعد آپ کو IES امتحان دینے پر شرح صدر نہیں ہورہا ہے تو آپ اس امتحان کے چکر میں نہ پڑیں۔ Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
